## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3><ol><li>Select a component, then click 1 element selected at the top left to open Properties. Expand Associations to inspect its classification references.</li><li>Use Search properties at the top of the Properties panel to filter its values.</li><li>Compare the classification references of two components.</li></ol><h2>Developer integration</h2><p>Import the original classification example with <code>viewer.add()</code>. Search and property inspection remain SDK controls. This page demonstrates reading the model's classifications, not editing them. The source model is about 395 MB.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
<h3>Model notes</h3><p>The original IFC source is imported unchanged.</p>
